title: 치키 55화 노래

songs.title: 눈싸움 놀이!
songs.style: jingly winter swing song for kids, 112 bpm, sleigh bells, glockenspiel, upright bass, soft 'poof' snow sound on each throw, cheerful female lead, toddler sing-along kids song, Korean lyrics, clear slow pronunciation, simple catchy melody with small note range, kids choir echoes the short shouts in brackets, major key
songs.lyrics:
[Chorus]
쿵쿵 쾅! 쿵쿵 쾅!
눈싸움 (하자!)
살살 던지며 놀아요
치키치키 눈싸움!

[Verse 1]
하얀 눈을 꼭꼭
눈 뭉치 (동글!)
하나 만들어요 (하나!)

[Verse 2]
살살 살살 던져요
휙 (휙!)
배에 퐁 (퐁!)

[Verse 3]
눈 벽 뒤에 쏙
숨어라 (쏙!)
토롱 머리 보여 (하하!)

[Verse 4]
얼굴은 피해요
살살 던져요 (살살!)
다 같이 웃어요 (하하!)

[Chorus]
쿵쿵 쾅! 쿵쿵 쾅!
눈싸움 (하자!)
살살 던지며 놀아요
치키치키 눈싸움!

[End]
